title.full: Getting help to apply for CPF money

summary.text: For an un-nominated CPF moneys application, get help online or visit a ServiceSG Centre.

steps.name: Get help applying
steps.text: Ask a family member or trusted friend to help you submit the online application, or visit a ServiceSG Centre.

items: Ask a family member or trusted friend to help you submit the online application.
Visit ServiceSG@Nee Soon Central Community Club, ServiceSG Centre Bukit Canberra, or ServiceSG@Keat Hong Community Club.
Visit ServiceSG@Kampong Chai Chee Community Club, ServiceSG@The Frontier Community Club, or ServiceSG Centre Our Tampines Hub.
Visit ServiceSG Centre One Punggol, ServiceSG Centre Woodlands, ServiceSG Centre Bukit Merah, or ServiceSG Centre Ang Mo Kio.
